CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_SECURITIESCUSTOMER_SEC
AS
BEGIN

--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TMP_BNKM_SecuritiesCustomer AS 
(
SELECT
	 BST.CLTCODE AS CustomerId
	,BST.INCORP_DATE AS IncorporatedDate
	,BST.INCORP_CERT AS IncorporatedCertificate
	,BST.BROKEREMPLOY AS BrokerEmployeeIndicator
	,BST.BROKEREMPNAME AS BrokerEmployorName
	,BST.PSEOFFICER AS PseOfficerIndicator
	,BST.PSECNAME AS PseCompleteName
	,BST.ACCTBROKER AS AccountBrokerIndicator
	,BST.ACCTBROKERNAME AS AccountBrokerName
	,BST.NETWORTH_CURR AS NetWorthCurrencyCode
	,BST.NETWORTH_RANGE AS NetWorthRange
	,BST.ANNINC_CURR AS AnnualIncomeCurrencyCode
	,BST.ANNINC_RANGE AS AnnualIncomeRange
	,BST.ASSETS_CURR AS AssetsCurrencyCode
	,BST.ASSETS_RANGE AS AssetsRange
	,BST.INCORP_COUNTRY AS IncorporateCountryId
	,BST.BROKEROFFICER AS BrokerOfficerIndicator
	,BST.RISKCLASS AS RiskClass
	,BST.SETA_BRANCHCODE AS BankCode
	,BST.SETA_BRANCHNAME AS BankBranch
	,BST.SETA_ACCTNO AS SettlementAccountNumber
	,BST.TRUSTFLAG AS TrustIndicator
	,BST.LFFLAG AS LocalForeignIndicator
	,BST.RELATEDPARTY_FLAG AS RelatedPartyIndicator
	,BST.AFFILIATEFLAG AS AffiliateIndicator
	,BST.BUSSECTOR AS BusinessSector
	,BST.CONTACTPERSON AS ContactPerson
	,BST.CONTACTPOSITION AS ContactionPosition
	,BST.LASTUPDATED AS LastUpdatedDate
	,BST.AMLC_WATCHLIST AS AmlcWatchlistIndicator
	,BST.PEPFLAG AS PepIndicator
	,BST.GOVTINST AS GovernmentInstitutionIndicator
	,BST.GOVTEMP AS GovernmentEmployeeIndicator
	,BST.NDVFLAG AS NdvIndicator
	,BST.BUSREG_CERT AS BusinessRegistrationCertificate
	,BST.STOCK_GRANTEE AS StockGranteeIndicator
	,BST.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,'SEC' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,BST.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
	,RECORD_STATUS
FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT_DELTA BSTD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BST ON BSTD.CLTCODE = BST.CLTCODE AND BST.ISLATEST = 1
)


SELECT * INTO #TMP_BNKM_SecuritiesCustomer FROM TMP_BNKM_SecuritiesCustomer;


-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TMP_BNKM_SecuritiesCustomer_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
	CustomerId
	,IncorporatedDate
	,IncorporatedCertificate
	,BrokerEmployeeIndicator
	,BrokerEmployorName
	,PseOfficerIndicator
	,PseCompleteName
	,AccountBrokerIndicator
	,AccountBrokerName
	,NetWorthCurrencyCode
	,NetWorthRange
	,AnnualIncomeCurrencyCode
	,AnnualIncomeRange
	,AssetsCurrencyCode
	,AssetsRange
	,IncorporateCountryId
	,BrokerOfficerIndicator
	,RiskClass
	,BankCode
	,BankBranch
	,SettlementAccountNumber
	,TrustIndicator
	,LocalForeignIndicator
	,RelatedPartyIndicator
	,AffiliateIndicator
	,BusinessSector
	,ContactPerson
	,ContactionPosition
	,LastUpdatedDate
	,AmlcWatchlistIndicator
	,PepIndicator
	,GovernmentInstitutionIndicator
	,GovernmentEmployeeIndicator
	,NdvIndicator
	,BusinessRegistrationCertificate
	,StockGranteeIndicator
	)) HASHROW, CustomerId, RECORD_STATUS 
FROM #TMP_BNKM_SecuritiesCustomer WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)
,
TMP_BNKM_SecuritiesCustomer_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
	CustomerId
	,IncorporatedDate
	,IncorporatedCertificate
	,BrokerEmployeeIndicator
	,BrokerEmployorName
	,PseOfficerIndicator
	,PseCompleteName
	,AccountBrokerIndicator
	,AccountBrokerName
	,NetWorthCurrencyCode
	,NetWorthRange
	,AnnualIncomeCurrencyCode
	,AnnualIncomeRange
	,AssetsCurrencyCode
	,AssetsRange
	,IncorporateCountryId
	,BrokerOfficerIndicator
	,RiskClass
	,BankCode
	,BankBranch
	,SettlementAccountNumber
	,TrustIndicator
	,LocalForeignIndicator
	,RelatedPartyIndicator
	,AffiliateIndicator
	,BusinessSector
	,ContactPerson
	,ContactionPosition
	,LastUpdatedDate
	,AmlcWatchlistIndicator
	,PepIndicator
	,GovernmentInstitutionIndicator
	,GovernmentEmployeeIndicator
	,NdvIndicator
	,BusinessRegistrationCertificate
	,StockGranteeIndicator
)) HASHROW, CustomerId
FROM BNKM.SecuritiesCustomer --WHERE SOURCE_CODE = 'SEC'	
)
,
TMP_BNKM_SecuritiesCustomer_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TMP_BNKM_SecuritiesCustomer_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TMP_BNKM_SecuritiesCustomer_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TMP_BNKM_SecuritiesCustomer_DELTA FROM TMP_BNKM_SecuritiesCustomer_DELTA;


---------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
		CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId
		,IncorporatedDate = SRC.IncorporatedDate
		,IncorporatedCertificate = SRC.IncorporatedCertificate
		,BrokerEmployeeIndicator = SRC.BrokerEmployeeIndicator
		,BrokerEmployorName = SRC.BrokerEmployorName
		,PseOfficerIndicator = SRC.PseOfficerIndicator
		,PseCompleteName = SRC.PseCompleteName
		,AccountBrokerIndicator = SRC.AccountBrokerIndicator
		,AccountBrokerName = SRC.AccountBrokerName
		,NetWorthCurrencyCode = SRC.NetWorthCurrencyCode
		,NetWorthRange = SRC.NetWorthRange
		,AnnualIncomeCurrencyCode = SRC.AnnualIncomeCurrencyCode
		,AnnualIncomeRange = SRC.AnnualIncomeRange
		,AssetsCurrencyCode = SRC.AssetsCurrencyCode
		,AssetsRange = SRC.AssetsRange
		,IncorporateCountryId = SRC.IncorporateCountryId
		,BrokerOfficerIndicator = SRC.BrokerOfficerIndicator
		,RiskClass = SRC.RiskClass
		,BankCode = SRC.BankCode
		,BankBranch = SRC.BankBranch
		,SettlementAccountNumber = SRC.SettlementAccountNumber
		,TrustIndicator = SRC.TrustIndicator
		,LocalForeignIndicator = SRC.LocalForeignIndicator
		,RelatedPartyIndicator = SRC.RelatedPartyIndicator
		,AffiliateIndicator = SRC.AffiliateIndicator
		,BusinessSector = SRC.BusinessSector
		,ContactPerson = SRC.ContactPerson
		,ContactionPosition = SRC.ContactionPosition
		,LastUpdatedDate = SRC.LastUpdatedDate
		,AmlcWatchlistIndicator = SRC.AmlcWatchlistIndicator
		,PepIndicator = SRC.PepIndicator
		,GovernmentInstitutionIndicator = SRC.GovernmentInstitutionIndicator
		,GovernmentEmployeeIndicator = SRC.GovernmentEmployeeIndicator
		,NdvIndicator = SRC.NdvIndicator
		,BusinessRegistrationCertificate = SRC.BusinessRegistrationCertificate
		,StockGranteeIndicator = SRC.StockGranteeIndicator
		,FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
		,SourceSystemCode = 'SEC'
		,TaskRunId = 0
		,WorkFlowId = 0
		,InsertDttm = getDate()
FROM BNKM.SecuritiesCustomer TGT
JOIN #TMP_BNKM_SecuritiesCustomer_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TMP_BNKM_SecuritiesCustomer SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId ;

 
-------INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.SecuritiesCustomer
(
	CustomerId
	,IncorporatedDate
	,IncorporatedCertificate
	,BrokerEmployeeIndicator
	,BrokerEmployorName
	,PseOfficerIndicator
	,PseCompleteName
	,AccountBrokerIndicator
	,AccountBrokerName
	,NetWorthCurrencyCode
	,NetWorthRange
	,AnnualIncomeCurrencyCode
	,AnnualIncomeRange
	,AssetsCurrencyCode
	,AssetsRange
	,IncorporateCountryId
	,BrokerOfficerIndicator
	,RiskClass
	,BankCode
	,BankBranch
	,SettlementAccountNumber
	,TrustIndicator
	,LocalForeignIndicator
	,RelatedPartyIndicator
	,AffiliateIndicator
	,BusinessSector
	,ContactPerson
	,ContactionPosition
	,LastUpdatedDate
	,AmlcWatchlistIndicator
	,PepIndicator
	,GovernmentInstitutionIndicator
	,GovernmentEmployeeIndicator
	,NdvIndicator
	,BusinessRegistrationCertificate
	,StockGranteeIndicator
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	,SourceSystemCode
	,TaskRunId
	,WorkFlowId
	,InsertDttm
)
SELECT
	CustomerId
	,IncorporatedDate
	,IncorporatedCertificate
	,BrokerEmployeeIndicator
	,BrokerEmployorName
	,PseOfficerIndicator
	,PseCompleteName
	,AccountBrokerIndicator
	,AccountBrokerName
	,NetWorthCurrencyCode
	,NetWorthRange
	,AnnualIncomeCurrencyCode
	,AnnualIncomeRange
	,AssetsCurrencyCode
	,AssetsRange
	,IncorporateCountryId
	,BrokerOfficerIndicator
	,RiskClass
	,BankCode
	,BankBranch
	,SettlementAccountNumber
	,TrustIndicator
	,LocalForeignIndicator
	,RelatedPartyIndicator
	,AffiliateIndicator
	,BusinessSector
	,ContactPerson
	,ContactionPosition
	,LastUpdatedDate
	,AmlcWatchlistIndicator
	,PepIndicator
	,GovernmentInstitutionIndicator
	,GovernmentEmployeeIndicator
	,NdvIndicator
	,BusinessRegistrationCertificate
	,StockGranteeIndicator
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	,SourceSystemCode
	,TaskRunId
	,WorkFlowId
	,InsertDttm
FROM #TMP_BNKM_SecuritiesCustomer
WHERE RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TMP_BNKM_SecuritiesCustomer;
DROP TABLE #TMP_BNKM_SecuritiesCustomer_DELTA;

END
